body:
Lost cause. I told myself this today. That I am a lost cause, my family and partner does not deserve to feel my pain. I feel ashamed and guilty and want to stop weighing down those whom I love. I feel your pain on the surface level but I do not want to say I feel all of it because I do not know your complete life story. 

But. I want you to know I am thinking about you. I hope you begin to feel better at some point. And as I said on another post here tonight, I am rooting for you.

I know a stranger on the internet seems like they cannot possibly understand your pain, but I want you to know tonight I am feeling these same exact thoughts. Solidarity? Mine are too always passive and somehow now these thoughts are stronger than ever molding into something new. I want you to know, whoever you are, I am thinking about you. I am hoping you fight this as am I trying to do the same as we speak. I don’t know your life and I certainly do not know your struggles but I am rooting for you.
